body_concept_v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art character concept sheet for Teamfight Manager 2, not a finished animation atlas. Simple blocky pixel drawing with a crisp dark outline, 12–16 flat colours, at most two shades per material, no tiny noisy armour detail, no smooth gradients, no photorealism. Proportions of a compact TFM2 stock melee champion: approximately 39 logical body pixels tall, normal-sized head and limbs, connected whole-body anatomy, readable at 1×. Actual RGBA transparent background.
